A PRIVATE GUIDE FOR LIFE AFTER A BREAKUP

Your life.

effect.text:
01
What may change

A Google password change signs you out in many places, with exceptions including some identity-verification devices and some connected apps or home devices.

boundary.text:
02
What stays outside this change

A password change alone does not review your location sharing, email forwarding or saved photo copies. Keep those checks in your plan if they apply.
